name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.196
notes: Refined Evidence Library viewing so each saved image shows image numbering and date/time.
Added optional per-image captions for explaining why a photo or screenshot matters.
Added tap-to-enlarge image viewing inside the existing modal workflow.
Improved Evidence Library guidance so users understand how documented evidence can help personal review and doctor visits.
label: EvidenceLibraryRefinement
summary: Refines the Evidence Library with image date/time, image numbering, optional captions, tap-to-enlarge viewing, and clearer user guidance for doctor-ready health-event evidence.
whatsNew: Evidence event images now show Evidence Photo 1 of N style numbering.
Each image can display an editable date/time using the selected file timestamp by default.
Each image supports an optional caption to explain what the photo or screenshot proves.
Tapping an image opens a larger view without adding albums, tags, OCR, AI, or automatic linking.
Evidence Library instructions now explain how to preserve one event narrative for later review or doctor visits.
changes: No unrelated activity, BP, medication, meal, symptom, Ask, weather, or backup behavior was changed.
testing: Confirmed Evidence Library button remains under Manage & Data.
Confirmed image date/time fields render in new and edit evidence event forms.
Confirmed optional image captions render in edit, event view, and enlarged image view.
Confirmed event view shows Evidence Photo 1 of N numbering.
Confirmed tapping an event image opens a larger modal view and returns to the event.
Verified CARDIACLENS_EVIDENCE_LIBRARY remains localStorage-based and is included by Export ALL Data automatically with existing localStorage export behavior.
Verified JavaScript syntax with node --check all.js.
